messages:
alex_cs: Hey team — kicking off Medinexus onboarding. They need Private (VPC) + Dedicated for the pilot (HIPAA). Goal: pilot in ~6 weeks. Core stakeholders: Olivia (PM), Raj (Security), Lin (Infra), Maya (CS lead), Tomas (Eng). Draft success criteria: 1) S3 ingestion + KMS key access validated end-to-end, 2) staging traffic shows P95 latency <= 400ms, 3) integration smoke tests pass, 4) two enablement sessions recorded and runbook delivered, 5) renewal check-in scheduled at 60 days post-pilot. Agree?

olivia_pm: Agree with criteria. Customer prefers Oct 20–22 for pilot start. Legal and procurement reviews are outstanding — I'll chase.

maya_success: Oct 20 window works if infra & security are firm by next Tue (9/16). I'll own the enablement content, checklist, and the 60-day renewal follow-up.

raj_se: Need Medinexus security questionnaire + SOC2 PDF. Also schedule a short threat-model review for the VPC peering and KMS policies. Who at Medinexus handles security docs?

alex_cs: Contact is sara@medinexus.com. Requested the questionnaire yesterday; she said they'll return it by EOD Friday. I'll upload to #secure-uploads when received.

lin_infra: On infra: we need their CIDR ranges, egress expectations, and whether they require static egress IPs for allowlisting. Also confirm KMS key policy and whether they want us to create the key or bring their CMK. Who will open the cloud provider ticket?

tomas_eng: I'll open the provision ticket once we have CIDRs and KMS info. Also customer asked about model options — recommend starting pilot with 13B int8 (better latency/cost) vs 70B which may breach the 400ms P95. Will prepare perf sims for the pilot profile.

onboard-bot: Scheduled: dev-vpc-provisioning job queued for 2025-09-10T14:00:00Z (owner: tomas_eng).

olivia_pm: I'll tell Medinexus we recommend 13B for pilot to hit latency target and shorten iteration time. I'll also confirm legal timeline with their procurement lead.

maya_success: I drafted the enablement checklist: "S3+KMS smoke tests, staging perf run (P95 <= 400ms), infra handoff call, 2 enablement sessions recorded, runbook delivered, renewal touchpoint at +60d." Raj, please add any security checkpoints.

raj_se: Add: we require questionnaire + proof of ownership for S3 bucket, SOC2 cert, and a short ingress/egress validation test. After those pass I can provide security sign-off.

alex_cs: Next steps: Olivia to confirm legal timeline and procurement contact; Lin/Tomas to submit cloud ticket + CIDRs by EOD Tue; Maya to finalize enablement plan by Wed; Alex will upload questionnaire when received and run Friday readiness check. :thumbsup:
